Tara: Noticed ~$9.6k in untagged GPU spend on project 'ml-ingest' last 48h. Looks like long-running preprocessing jobs that lost labels after a controller restart. Can we decide allocation before close? cc @Marcus @Devon

billing-bot: Alert: GPU spend anomaly for project ml-ingest. Delta +$9,623 in 48h. Export: https://billing.internal/exports/1898765432-ml-ingest.csv

Marcus: Can you paste the top rows? I want instance types and timestamps.

Tara: small snippet:
```
2026-03-15T11:02Z, inst-a12, n1-highmem-16, us-east1, gpu-a10, 4.8
2026-03-15T11:05Z, inst-a12, n1-highmem-16, us-east1, gpu-a10, 4.7
2026-03-16T02:40Z, inst-b03, n1-standard-32, us-central1, gpu-v100, 0.9
```

Devon: If it's our controller restart, Platform should take most. Proposal: split 50% DataScience / 50% Platform for now, pending vendor case for potential meter correction.

Lena: Finance viewpoint: approve provisional split 50/50 but require a FIN-REQ tagging and ledger memo. Also approve temporary internal credit of $5k from Platform contingency (GL: PLAT-OPS-2026).

Marcus: I'll run backfill to tag the affected instance_ids with label='controller-restart' and attributed_team='ml-ingest' (dry-run first). SQL I'll use (dry-run):
```
SELECT instance_id, meter_id, ts, cost FROM billing.gpu_usage
WHERE project='ml-ingest' AND ts >= '2026-03-14' AND label IS NULL LIMIT 100;
```

billing-bot: Ticket created: Case 765432 with Cloud Billing Support. Expect response 3-5 business days. Please attach instance CSV.

Tara: I'll prepare CSV and ledger entry: DataScience 50% -> GL DS-EXP-2026, Platform 50% -> GL PLAT-OPS-2026. Note: "provisional allocation pending vendor credit (Case 765432)". Leaving thread open until vendor responds.
